blocks.text: After hours of scrolling, answering messages, and switching between tabs, taking a break from screens can feel like a luxury. At Ayala Center Cebu, there is now a space that invites shoppers to slow down, put their phones aside, and rediscover the simple pleasures of doing things offline. Ayala Center Cebu has opened Analog Alley, a new common space on Level 1 across from Allbirds, featuring a vinyl record listening booth, a mahjong table, reading nooks, and open seating areas designed around screen-free activities.
